narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience on the recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence specifically used for identifying animal emotions and physical pain. It uses scientific studies (from the journal Science) and software examples (Sheep Pain Analyzer) to argue that AI is becoming more reliable than humans in veterinary and husbandry contexts.
